sloka: अङ्केन आदाय वैदेहीम् अपक्रम्य तदा अब्रवीत् ।युवाम् जटा चीर धरौ सभार्यौ क्षीण जीवितौ ॥३-२-१०॥
transliteration: aṅkena ādāya vaidehīm apakramya tadā abravīt ।yuvām jaṭā cīra dharau sabhāryau kṣīṇa jīvitau ॥3-2-10॥

translations.english: You both clad in bark and wearing matted hair, holding bows, arrows and swords have entered into the Dandaka forest with your wife. Your life has been cut short indeed৷৷
